Desktop OS.reason_zh: Dell Alienware Command Center存在违反最小权限原则的缺陷，允许低权限本地用户提升至管理员权限并触发拒绝服务（DoS），直接威胁桌面工作站安全。

Mobile Security.reason: OS command injection in PingTools Network Utilities' ICMP Watcher allows local attackers to execute arbitrary commands by manipulating the Host field.
Mobile Security.reason_en: OS command injection in PingTools Network Utilities' ICMP Watcher allows local attackers to execute arbitrary commands by manipulating the Host field.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: PingTools Network Utilities的ICMP Watcher中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许本地攻击者通过操纵Host字段执行任意命令。

Mobile Security.reason: The Android SDK synchronous POST path overrides disabled redirect settings, potentially exposing sensitive agent communication data to man-in-the-middle attacks on mobile clients.
Mobile Security.reason_en: The Android SDK synchronous POST path overrides disabled redirect settings, potentially exposing sensitive agent communication data to man-in-the-middle attacks on mobile clients.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Android SDK的同步POST请求路径会覆盖已禁用的重定向设置，可能导致移动客户端上的敏感代理通信数据暴露于中间人攻击之下。

Mobile Security.reason: Saturating the call state machine queue prevents local hangup signals from tearing down audio/video tracks, enabling persistent unwanted connections and resource exhaustion.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Saturating the call state machine queue prevents local hangup signals from tearing down audio/video tracks, enabling persistent unwanted connections and resource exhaustion.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: 呼叫状态机队列被填满会阻塞本地挂断信号，导致音视频轨道无法断开，从而引发持久化非法连接与资源耗尽。

Mobile Security.reason: Auto-accept feature mishandles absolute file paths in friend messages, allowing attackers to overwrite critical system files or plant malicious resume records on victim devices.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Auto-accept feature mishandles absolute file paths in friend messages, allowing attackers to overwrite critical system files or plant malicious resume records on victim devices.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: “自动接受”功能未能正确处理好友消息中的绝对文件路径，攻击者可借此覆盖关键系统文件或向受害设备植入恶意恢复记录。

IoT Security.reason: OS command injection in the Totolink X2000R's peerRptPin functionality allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary system commands via crafted HTTP requests.
IoT Security.reason_en: OS command injection in the Totolink X2000R's peerRptPin functionality allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary system commands via crafted HTTP requests.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Totolink X2000R的peerRptPin功能中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许已认证攻击者通过构造的HTTP请求执行任意系统命令。

IoT Security.reason: A stack-based buffer overflow in the device hostname handling routine can be triggered by malformed HTTP traffic, leading to complete device compromise.
IoT Security.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in the device hostname handling routine can be triggered by malformed HTTP traffic, leading to complete device compromise.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 设备主机名处理例程中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过畸形HTTP流量触发，导致设备被完全控制。

IoT Security.reason: Path traversal in the EyeLock nano NXT biometric scanner's log download endpoint permits unauthenticated attackers to read sensitive system files like /etc/passwd.
IoT Security.reason_en: Path traversal in the EyeLock nano NXT biometric scanner's log download endpoint permits unauthenticated attackers to read sensitive system files like /etc/passwd.
IoT Security.reason_zh: EyeLock nano NXT生物识别扫描仪的日志下载接口存在路径遍历漏洞，允许未经身份验证的攻击者读取/etc/passwd等敏感系统文件。

IoT Security.reason: Authenticated stack-based buffer overflow in TP-Link Tapo's Wi-Fi onboarding path enables adjacent network attackers to overwrite stack state and execute commands.
IoT Security.reason_en: Authenticated stack-based buffer overflow in TP-Link Tapo's Wi-Fi onboarding path enables adjacent network attackers to overwrite stack state and execute commands.
IoT Security.reason_zh: TP-Link Tapo的Wi-Fi配网流程中存在需认证的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许同网段攻击者覆盖栈内存并执行命令。

IoT Security.reason: Buffer overflow in Zephyr's OSDP Control Panel reply parser processes unvalidated payload lengths, potentially corrupting stack memory on peripheral devices.
IoT Security.reason_en: Buffer overflow in Zephyr's OSDP Control Panel reply parser processes unvalidated payload lengths, potentially corrupting stack memory on peripheral devices.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Zephyr的OSDP控制面板回复解析器中存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，其处理未经验证的有效载荷长度，可能破坏外围设备的栈内存。

IoT Security.reason: Uninitialized pointer dereference in Eclipse ThreadX's HTTP server triggers crashes or exploitation when processing malformed PUT requests from unauthenticated clients.
IoT Security.reason_en: Uninitialized pointer dereference in Eclipse ThreadX's HTTP server triggers crashes or exploitation when processing malformed PUT requests from unauthenticated clients.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Eclipse ThreadX的HTTP服务器中存在未初始化指针解引用漏洞，在处理来自未认证客户端的畸形PUT请求时会引发崩溃或被利用。

IoT Security.reason: Critical out-of-bounds write in TLS certificate parsing allows remote code execution or denial of service on embedded devices using the NetX Secure networking stack.
IoT Security.reason_en: Critical out-of-bounds write in TLS certificate parsing allows remote code execution or denial of service on embedded devices using the NetX Secure networking stack.
IoT Security.reason_zh: TLS证书解析过程中存在严重的越界写入漏洞，可导致使用NetX Secure网络栈的嵌入式设备发生远程代码执行或拒绝服务。

IoT Security.reason: Incorrect MPU configuration allows unprivileged tasks to read and write kernel memory, completely breaking real-time OS isolation and enabling full device compromise.
IoT Security.reason_en: Incorrect MPU configuration allows unprivileged tasks to read and write kernel memory, completely breaking real-time OS isolation and enabling full device compromise.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 错误的MPU（内存保护单元）配置允许非特权任务读写内核内存，彻底破坏实时操作系统的隔离机制，从而导致设备被完全控制。

IoT Security.reason: Fault-tolerant FAT mounting triggers attacker-controlled heap writes during log replay, enabling instruction pointer hijacking on embedded systems with common memory layouts.
IoT Security.reason_en: Fault-tolerant FAT mounting triggers attacker-controlled heap writes during log replay, enabling instruction pointer hijacking on embedded systems with common memory layouts.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 容错FAT挂载在日志重放期间触发攻击者控制的堆写入，导致具有常见内存布局的嵌入式系统发生指令指针劫持。

IoT Security.reason: Missing validation on font glyph ranges causes arithmetic underflow during binary resource loading, risking memory corruption in embedded graphical interfaces.
IoT Security.reason_en: Missing validation on font glyph ranges causes arithmetic underflow during binary resource loading, risking memory corruption in embedded graphical interfaces.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 字体字形范围缺乏验证，在加载二进制资源时引发算术下溢，可能导致嵌入式图形界面发生内存损坏。

IoT Security.reason: Integer overflow in TLS message length parsing enables memory corruption, compromising secure communications on resource-constrained IoT devices.
IoT Security.reason_en: Integer overflow in TLS message length parsing enables memory corruption, compromising secure communications on resource-constrained IoT devices.
IoT Security.reason_zh: TLS消息长度解析中的整数溢出可导致内存损坏，危及资源受限IoT设备的通信安全。

Cloud Security.reason: A Kubernetes tenant can deploy arbitrary container images, granting the operator cluster-wide privileges and enabling full environment takeover.
Cloud Security.reason_en: A Kubernetes tenant can deploy arbitrary container images, granting the operator cluster-wide privileges and enabling full environment takeover.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Kubernetes租户可部署任意容器镜像，从而赋予Operator集群级权限并实现环境的完全接管。

Cloud Security.reason: Improper certificate validation in Microsoft Partner Center allows unauthorized privilege escalation across cloud management interfaces.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Improper certificate validation in Microsoft Partner Center allows unauthorized privilege escalation across cloud management interfaces.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Partner Center中证书验证不当，允许跨云管理接口进行未授权提权。

Cloud Security.reason: Missing authentication in Azure App Service enables remote code execution, severely compromising cloud application deployments.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure App Service enables remote code execution, severely compromising cloud application deployments.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure App Service缺失身份验证可导致远程代码执行，严重危及云应用部署安全。

Cloud Security.reason: Unvalidated input in the Azure Key Vault KMS provider triggers SSRF attacks that exfiltrate sensitive bearer tokens from the proxy.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Unvalidated input in the Azure Key Vault KMS provider triggers SSRF attacks that exfiltrate sensitive bearer tokens from the proxy.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure Key Vault KMS提供程序中未经验证的输入会触发SSRF攻击，从代理处窃取敏感的Bearer令牌。

Cloud Security.reason: OS command injection in Azure CycleCloud enables local privilege escalation within cloud batch processing environments, risking tenant isolation.
Cloud Security.reason_en: OS command injection in Azure CycleCloud enables local privilege escalation within cloud batch processing environments, risking tenant isolation.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud中的OS命令注入可在云批处理环境中实现本地提权，威胁租户隔离性。

Cloud Security.reason: Improper access control in the Windows Container Isolation FS Filter Driver weakens container security boundaries, increasing lateral movement risks.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Improper access control in the Windows Container Isolation FS Filter Driver weakens container security boundaries, increasing lateral movement risks.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Windows Container Isolation FS Filter Driver中访问控制不当削弱了容器安全边界，增加了横向移动风险。

Cloud Security.reason: Information disclosure in Active Directory Federation Services exposes sensitive authentication metadata, potentially aiding identity-based attacks.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Information disclosure in Active Directory Federation Services exposes sensitive authentication metadata, potentially aiding identity-based attacks.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services中的信息泄露会暴露敏感认证元数据，可能助长基于身份的攻击。

Cloud Security.reason: Cryptographic signature bypass in the .NET runtime undermines software integrity verification, affecting secure deployment pipelines and cloud workloads.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Cryptographic signature bypass in the .NET runtime undermines software integrity verification, affecting secure deployment pipelines and cloud workloads.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: .NET运行时中的密码学签名绕过破坏了软件完整性验证，影响安全部署流水线与云工作负载。

Cloud Security.reason: CVSS 8.2 improper channel restriction in Azure Key Vault allows attackers to elevate privileges and potentially access sensitive cryptographic material over the network.
Cloud Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.2 improper channel restriction in Azure Key Vault allows attackers to elevate privileges and potentially access sensitive cryptographic material over the network.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: CVSS 8.2 Azure Key Vault中通道限制不当，允许攻击者提权并通过网络访问敏感加密材料。

Cloud Security.reason: CVSS 7.4 weak authentication in Azure Key Vault enables unauthorized users to bypass security controls and manipulate cloud secrets.
Cloud Security.reason_en: CVSS 7.4 weak authentication in Azure Key Vault enables unauthorized users to bypass security controls and manipulate cloud secrets.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: CVSS 7.4 Azure Key Vault中身份验证机制薄弱，使未授权用户能够绕过安全控制并操纵云机密。

Cloud Security.reason: Out-of-bounds read in Azure Attestation exposes sensitive hardware and software trust metrics over the network, undermining secure cloud onboarding.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Azure Attestation exposes sensitive hardware and software trust metrics over the network, undermining secure cloud onboarding.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure Attestation中的越界读取漏洞通过网络暴露敏感的软硬件信任指标，破坏安全的云接入流程。

Cloud Security.reason: Untrusted input handling in Active Directory Federation Services allows network-based spoofing, jeopardizing federated identity verification and session integrity.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Untrusted input handling in Active Directory Federation Services allows network-based spoofing, jeopardizing federated identity verification and session integrity.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services中不可信输入处理不当会导致网络欺骗，危及联合身份验证与会话完整性。

Cloud Security.reason: Missing resource throttling in AD FS enables network denial-of-service attacks, potentially disrupting enterprise cloud identity and access management.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Missing resource throttling in AD FS enables network denial-of-service attacks, potentially disrupting enterprise cloud identity and access management.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: AD FS中缺失资源限流机制可被用于发起网络拒绝服务攻击，可能中断企业云身份与访问管理服务。

Cloud Security.reason: Information disclosure in Azure HDInsight exposes sensitive data to unauthorized actors, compromising cloud analytics workloads and multi-tenant isolation.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Information disclosure in Azure HDInsight exposes sensitive data to unauthorized actors, compromising cloud analytics workloads and multi-tenant isolation.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure HDInsight中的信息泄露会将敏感数据暴露给未授权方，危及云分析工作负载与多租户隔离。

Cloud Security.reason: Origin validation failure in Microsoft Power Apps allows cross-origin attacks leading to remote code execution in cloud-hosted business applications.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Origin validation failure in Microsoft Power Apps allows cross-origin attacks leading to remote code execution in cloud-hosted business applications.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Power Apps中源验证失败可导致跨域攻击，进而引发云托管业务应用的远程代码执行。

Cloud Security.reason: Weak authentication in Active Directory Federation Services enables network spoofing attacks, undermining identity management for cloud SaaS integrations and single sign-on flows.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Weak authentication in Active Directory Federation Services enables network spoofing attacks, undermining identity management for cloud SaaS integrations and single sign-on flows.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services中身份验证机制薄弱易受网络欺骗攻击，破坏云SaaS集成与单点登录流程的身份管理。

Cloud Security.reason: CVSS 10.0 arbitrary Redis write in IBM Cloud Pak for Data collapses tenant isolation boundaries, enabling anonymous attackers to poison cached parameters across tenants.
Cloud Security.reason_en: CVSS 10.0 arbitrary Redis write in IBM Cloud Pak for Data collapses tenant isolation boundaries, enabling anonymous attackers to poison cached parameters across tenants.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: CVSS 10.0 IBM Cloud Pak for Data中存在任意Redis写入漏洞，破坏租户隔离边界，使匿名攻击者能够跨租户污染缓存参数。

Cloud Security.reason: The RHACS Central SAML endpoint fails to validate assertion identifiers, enabling replay attacks that could bypass authentication controls in Kubernetes cluster security environments.
Cloud Security.reason_en: The RHACS Central SAML endpoint fails to validate assertion identifiers, enabling replay attacks that could bypass authentication controls in Kubernetes cluster security environments.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: RHACS Central SAML端点未能验证断言标识符，导致重放攻击可绕过Kubernetes集群安全环境中的身份验证控制。

Cloud Security.reason: Misconfigured IAM policies in the AWS serverless CICD toolchain allow authenticated repository pushers to escalate privileges and access resources outside their designated stack.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Misconfigured IAM policies in the AWS serverless CICD toolchain allow authenticated repository pushers to escalate privileges and access resources outside their designated stack.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: AWS无服务器CICD工具链中配置错误的IAM策略允许已认证的仓库推送者提权并访问其指定栈之外的资源。

Cloud Security.reason: Truncating allocation sizes during VM live migration in spice-server enables malicious SPICE clients to trigger massive heap buffer overflows, compromising host stability.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Truncating allocation sizes during VM live migration in spice-server enables malicious SPICE clients to trigger massive heap buffer overflows, compromising host stability.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: spice-server在VM实时迁移过程中截断分配大小，使恶意SPICE客户端能够触发大规模堆缓冲区溢出，危及主机稳定性。

Cloud Security.reason: Flawed authorization logic in OpenChoreo's workflow update route bypasses project and component validation, allowing unauthorized modification of containerized workflows.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Flawed authorization logic in OpenChoreo's workflow update route bypasses project and component validation, allowing unauthorized modification of containerized workflows.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: OpenChoreo工作流更新路由中存在的缺陷授权逻辑绕过了项目与组件验证，允许未授权修改容器化工作流。

Cloud Security.reason: Missing authorization in Amazon Kiro Crew's WhatsApp integration allows remote operators to hijack agent sessions and execute arbitrary host commands.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Missing authorization in Amazon Kiro Crew's WhatsApp integration allows remote operators to hijack agent sessions and execute arbitrary host commands.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Amazon Kiro Crew的WhatsApp集成中缺失授权机制，允许远程操作者劫持智能体会话并执行任意主机命令。

Cloud Security.reason: Default HTTP/2 limits in Cloudflare Pingora enable unauthenticated clients to exhaust server resources via near-empty header HPACK references.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Default HTTP/2 limits in Cloudflare Pingora enable unauthenticated clients to exhaust server resources via near-empty header HPACK references.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Cloudflare Pingora默认的HTTP/2限制可使未认证客户端通过近乎空的Header HPACK引用耗尽服务器资源。

Cloud Security.reason: Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking in Google Cloud Shell permits unauthenticated attackers to steal active user OAuth tokens via cross-origin requests.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking in Google Cloud Shell permits unauthenticated attackers to steal active user OAuth tokens via cross-origin requests.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Google Cloud Shell中的跨站WebSocket劫持漏洞允许未认证攻击者通过跨域请求窃取活跃用户的OAuth令牌。

Cloud Security.reason: Argo CD passes unsanitized query values to git fetch, enabling command injection through leading-hyphen arguments in remote resource URLs.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Argo CD passes unsanitized query values to git fetch, enabling command injection through leading-hyphen arguments in remote resource URLs.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Argo CD将未过滤的查询值传递给git fetch，攻击者可利用远程资源URL中的前导连字符参数实现命令注入。

Cloud Security.reason: Jsonnet evaluation in Argo CD lacks repository confinement, allowing absolute paths and parent-directory traversals to execute arbitrary code.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Jsonnet evaluation in Argo CD lacks repository confinement, allowing absolute paths and parent-directory traversals to execute arbitrary code.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Argo CD中的Jsonnet评估缺乏仓库隔离限制，允许使用绝对路径和父目录遍历来执行任意代码。

Cloud Security.reason: Default configuration exposes an unauthenticated REST API with local execution backend, allowing remote attackers to bypass sandboxing and execute arbitrary commands.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Default configuration exposes an unauthenticated REST API with local execution backend, allowing remote attackers to bypass sandboxing and execute arbitrary commands.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 默认配置暴露了带有本地执行后端的未认证REST API，使远程攻击者能够绕过沙箱限制并执行任意命令。

Cloud Security.reason: Exposed chat endpoints lack authentication and execute shell commands via AI tools, allowing remote attackers to fully compromise the underlying host system.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Exposed chat endpoints lack authentication and execute shell commands via AI tools, allowing remote attackers to fully compromise the underlying host system.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 暴露的聊天端点缺乏身份验证，并通过AI工具执行Shell命令，使远程攻击者能够完全控制底层主机系统。

Cloud Security.reason: Default Docker configuration disables authentication middleware and exposes PostgreSQL with default credentials, enabling immediate remote code execution and database takeover.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Default Docker configuration disables authentication middleware and exposes PostgreSQL with default credentials, enabling immediate remote code execution and database takeover.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 默认的Docker配置禁用了身份验证中间件，并以默认凭据暴露PostgreSQL，导致可立即进行远程代码执行和数据库接管。

Cloud Security.reason: Authenticated customers can take ownership of host directories via symlink abuse in cron jobs, escalating to full server compromise and data exfiltration.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Authenticated customers can take ownership of host directories via symlink abuse in cron jobs, escalating to full server compromise and data exfiltration.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 已认证客户可通过滥用cron作业中的符号链接获取主机目录的所有权，进而升级为完全控制服务器并窃取数据。

Cloud Security.reason: Mock user validation grants admin role to all callers, enabling unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands through the AI agent's unsandboxed tools.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Mock user validation grants admin role to all callers, enabling unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands through the AI agent's unsandboxed tools.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 模拟用户验证机制将所有调用者授予管理员角色，使未认证的攻击者能够通过AI代理的非沙箱化工具执行任意命令。

Cloud Security.reason: Operator WebSocket upgrades fail to verify bearer tokens, allowing self-minted admin tokens to bypass RBAC and gain full control over fog computing nodes.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Operator WebSocket upgrades fail to verify bearer tokens, allowing self-minted admin tokens to bypass RBAC and gain full control over fog computing nodes.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 操作员WebSocket升级未能验证Bearer令牌，允许自制的管理员令牌绕过基于角色的访问控制（RBAC），从而完全控制雾计算节点。

Cloud Security.reason: KEDA allows namespace administrators to redirect Vault authentication to attacker-controlled endpoints, enabling credential theft and unauthorized access to sensitive Kubernetes cluster secrets.
Cloud Security.reason_en: KEDA allows namespace administrators to redirect Vault authentication to attacker-controlled endpoints, enabling credential theft and unauthorized access to sensitive Kubernetes cluster secrets.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: KEDA允许命名空间管理员将Vault身份验证重定向至攻击者控制的端点，从而导致凭据泄露及未经授权访问敏感的Kubernetes集群密钥。

Cloud Security.reason: Red Hat insights-runtime-extractor runs with hostPID privileges and improper namespace isolation, creating a container escape risk that compromises the underlying host node.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Red Hat insights-runtime-extractor runs with hostPID privileges and improper namespace isolation, creating a container escape risk that compromises the underlying host node.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Red Hat insights-runtime-extractor以hostPID特权运行且命名空间隔离不当，存在容器逃逸风险，可能导致底层主机节点被攻陷。

Cloud Security.reason: OpenShift insights-operator-gather grants unrestricted cluster-wide secret read access due to overly permissive ClusterRole bindings, significantly increasing data exfiltration risks.
Cloud Security.reason_en: OpenShift insights-operator-gather grants unrestricted cluster-wide secret read access due to overly permissive ClusterRole bindings, significantly increasing data exfiltration risks.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: OpenShift insights-operator-gather因ClusterRole绑定权限过大而授予无限制的集群范围密钥读取权限，显著增加了数据泄露风险。

Network Devices.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in the DNS Server service allows remote code execution, threatening critical network infrastructure reliability.
Network Devices.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the DNS Server service allows remote code execution, threatening critical network infrastructure reliability.
Network Devices.reason_zh: DNS Server服务的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，威胁关键网络基础设施的可靠性。

Network Devices.reason: Use-after-free vulnerability in OpenSSH for Windows enables remote code execution, undermining secure remote access protocols.
Network Devices.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in OpenSSH for Windows enables remote code execution, undermining secure remote access protocols.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows版OpenSSH的使用后释放漏洞可导致远程代码执行，破坏安全远程访问协议。

Network Devices.reason: Schannel spoofing vulnerability compromises TLS handshake validation, allowing potential man-in-the-middle attacks on encrypted communications.
Network Devices.reason_en: Schannel spoofing vulnerability compromises TLS handshake validation, allowing potential man-in-the-middle attacks on encrypted communications.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Schannel欺骗漏洞破坏了TLS握手验证，可能导致加密通信遭受中间人攻击。

Network Devices.reason: Buffer length validation failure in NDIS.sys permits local privilege escalation through crafted network driver interactions.
Network Devices.reason_en: Buffer length validation failure in NDIS.sys permits local privilege escalation through crafted network driver interactions.
Network Devices.reason_zh: NDIS.sys中的缓冲区长度验证失败漏洞，可通过构造的网络驱动程序交互实现本地提权。

Network Devices.reason: Heap overflow in Network Policy Server permits unauthorized network-wide code execution, compromising authentication and authorization infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_en: Heap overflow in Network Policy Server permits unauthorized network-wide code execution, compromising authentication and authorization infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Network Policy Server的堆溢出漏洞允许未经授权的跨网络代码执行，破坏身份验证与授权基础设施。

Network Devices.reason: Critical RCE in the DHCP Server disrupts core network infrastructure and allows remote exploitation without user interaction.
Network Devices.reason_en: Critical RCE in the DHCP Server disrupts core network infrastructure and allows remote exploitation without user interaction.
Network Devices.reason_zh: DHCP Server中的严重远程代码执行漏洞会破坏核心网络基础设施，并允许在无用户交互的情况下进行远程利用。

Network Devices.reason_en: Use-after-free in Remote Desktop Gateway Service enables remote code execution over network connections, exposing remote access deployments.

Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 10.0 vulnerability allows unauthenticated network attackers to compromise Oracle Access Manager via HTTP, posing a critical identity management and authentication bypass risk.

Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 9.6 flaw enables low-privileged network attackers to compromise Oracle HTTP Server via HTTP, directly threatening web infrastructure availability and confidentiality.

Web Security.reason: CVSS 9.8 vulnerability permits unauthenticated HTTP access to compromise the Oracle Application Object Library, undermining core E-Business Suite application security.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 vulnerability permits unauthenticated HTTP access to compromise the Oracle Application Object Library, undermining core E-Business Suite application security.
Web Security.reason_zh: CVSS评分为9.8的漏洞允许未经身份验证的HTTP访问攻破Oracle Application Object Library，破坏E-Business Suite核心应用安全性。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 9.1 issue allows unauthenticated network attackers to compromise Oracle WebLogic Server core components via HTTP, risking full middleware takeover.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 9.1 issue allows unauthenticated network attackers to compromise Oracle WebLogic Server core components via HTTP, risking full middleware takeover.

Web Security.reason: Critical vulnerability in Oracle APEX allows unauthenticated remote attackers to compromise web applications built on the widely adopted low-code platform.
Web Security.reason_en: Critical vulnerability in Oracle APEX allows unauthenticated remote attackers to compromise web applications built on the widely adopted low-code platform.

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated HTTP exploitation in Primavera Unifier exposes web-based construction and engineering management systems to full compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated HTTP exploitation in Primavera Unifier exposes web-based construction and engineering management systems to full compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: Primavera Unifier中的未经身份验证的HTTP利用漏洞使基于Web的建筑与工程管理系统面临被完全攻陷的风险。

Web Security.reason: Flaw in Oracle's Dynamo Commerce Server enables low-privilege network attackers to disrupt e-commerce platforms and exfiltrate sensitive transactional data.
Web Security.reason_en: Flaw in Oracle's Dynamo Commerce Server enables low-privilege network attackers to disrupt e-commerce platforms and exfiltrate sensitive transactional data.

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated HTTP exploitation in Oracle WebCenter Sites enables complete compromise of the web content management platform without prior credentials.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated HTTP exploitation in Oracle WebCenter Sites enables complete compromise of the web content management platform without prior credentials.
Web Security.reason_zh: Oracle WebCenter Sites中的未经身份验证的HTTP利用漏洞可在无凭据的情况下实现对Web内容管理平台的完全控制。

Web Security.reason: Path-scoped middleware mount path divergence in @fastify/middie creates routing bypasses that can expose internal application endpoints to unauthorized access.
Web Security.reason_en: Path-scoped middleware mount path divergence in @fastify/middie creates routing bypasses that can expose internal application endpoints to unauthorized access.
Web Security.reason_zh: @fastify/middie中的路径作用域中间件挂载路径分歧会创建路由绕过漏洞，可能导致内部应用端点暴露于未授权访问之下。

Web Security.reason: PHP file inclusion vulnerability in the Issuu Panel WordPress plugin allows unauthenticated attackers to inject and execute remote or local malicious scripts.
Web Security.reason_en: PHP file inclusion vulnerability in the Issuu Panel WordPress plugin allows unauthenticated attackers to inject and execute remote or local malicious scripts.
Web Security.reason_zh: WordPress插件Issuu Panel中的PHP文件包含漏洞允许未经身份验证的攻击者注入并执行远程或本地恶意脚本。

Web Security.reason: SQL injection via the CityId parameter in FooSun DotNetCMS permits unauthenticated database manipulation, data exfiltration, and potential backend takeover.
Web Security.reason_en: SQL injection via the CityId parameter in FooSun DotNetCMS permits unauthenticated database manipulation, data exfiltration, and potential backend takeover.
Web Security.reason_zh: FooSun DotNetCMS中通过CityId参数进行的SQL注入漏洞允许未经身份验证的数据库操作、数据泄露及潜在的后端接管。

Web Security.reason: Unrestricted file upload in Eptura allows attackers to upload and execute JSP code, chaining with authentication bypass to achieve full system compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: Unrestricted file upload in Eptura allows attackers to upload and execute JSP code, chaining with authentication bypass to achieve full system compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: Eptura中的无限制文件上传漏洞允许攻击者上传并执行JSP代码，结合身份验证绕过可实现系统完全控制。

Web Security.reason: OS command injection in aaPanel's file manager ExecShell function allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary operating system commands.
Web Security.reason_en: OS command injection in aaPanel's file manager ExecShell function allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary operating system commands.
Web Security.reason_zh: aaPanel文件管理器ExecShell函数中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许远程攻击者执行任意系统命令。

Web Security.reason: Plex Media Server admin can write arbitrary files executed on load due to unsafe handling of transcoder options, leading to remote code execution (CISA KEV).
Web Security.reason_en: Plex Media Server admin can write arbitrary files executed on load due to unsafe handling of transcoder options, leading to remote code execution (CISA KEV).
Web Security.reason_zh: 由于对转码器选项处理不安全，Plex Media Server管理员可写入任意文件并在加载时执行，从而导致远程代码执行（列入CISA KEV）。

Web Security.reason: Blind SQL injection in wpdreams Ajax Search Pro allows attackers to manipulate database contents, exfiltrate data, or modify/delete records.
Web Security.reason_en: Blind SQL injection in wpdreams Ajax Search Pro allows attackers to manipulate database contents, exfiltrate data, or modify/delete records.
Web Security.reason_zh: wpdreams Ajax Search Pro中的盲SQL注入漏洞允许攻击者操纵数据库内容、窃取数据或修改/删除记录。

Web Security.reason: Authentication middleware incorrectly trusts client-controlled headers, allowing attackers to bypass login requirements and gain unauthorized access to administrative functions.
Web Security.reason_en: Authentication middleware incorrectly trusts client-controlled headers, allowing attackers to bypass login requirements and gain unauthorized access to administrative functions.
Web Security.reason_zh: 身份验证中间件错误地信任由客户端控制的请求头，使攻击者能够绕过登录要求并获取管理功能的未授权访问权限。

Web Security.reason: Authenticated administrators can escape the Twig template sandbox by injecting malicious object behaviors, leading to full remote code execution on the CMS server.
Web Security.reason_en: Authenticated administrators can escape the Twig template sandbox by injecting malicious object behaviors, leading to full remote code execution on the CMS server.
Web Security.reason_zh: 已认证的管理员可通过注入恶意对象行为逃逸Twig模板沙箱，导致CMS服务器发生完整的远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Site-scoped GraphQL tokens can mutate cross-site content due to missing enforcement, allowing attackers to delete or modify entries across multiple websites.
Web Security.reason_en: Site-scoped GraphQL tokens can mutate cross-site content due to missing enforcement, allowing attackers to delete or modify entries across multiple websites.
Web Security.reason_zh: 由于缺乏强制实施机制，站点范围的GraphQL令牌可跨站修改内容，使攻击者能够删除或修改多个网站中的条目。

Web Security.reason: Compromised plugin packages contain active malware capable of full website takeover, representing a critical supply-chain risk affecting thousands of WordPress installations.
Web Security.reason_en: Compromised plugin packages contain active malware capable of full website takeover, representing a critical supply-chain risk affecting thousands of WordPress installations.
Web Security.reason_zh: 被篡改的插件包包含可完全接管网站的活跃恶意软件，构成影响数千个WordPress安装实例的关键供应链风险。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated visitors can inject JavaScript into agent browsers via co-browsing features, enabling session hijacking, credential theft, or malware distribution.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated visitors can inject JavaScript into agent browsers via co-browsing features, enabling session hijacking, credential theft, or malware distribution.
Web Security.reason_zh: 未认证访客可通过协同浏览功能向代理浏览器注入JavaScript，从而实现会话劫持、凭证窃取或恶意软件分发。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated endpoint caches full translation dictionaries for every language code, enabling rapid memory exhaustion and denial of service against the CMS API.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated endpoint caches full translation dictionaries for every language code, enabling rapid memory exhaustion and denial of service against the CMS API.
Web Security.reason_zh: 未认证端点会缓存每种语言代码的完整翻译词典，导致内存快速耗尽并对CMS API造成拒绝服务攻击。

Web Security.reason: Adobe Commerce template engine vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious code, resulting in remote code execution and complete account compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: Adobe Commerce template engine vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious code, resulting in remote code execution and complete account compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: Adobe Commerce模板引擎漏洞允许未认证攻击者注入恶意代码，导致远程代码执行及账户完全失陷。

Web Security.reason: EspoCRM authenticated administrators can store crafted serialized PHP objects that are later deserialized without validation, leading to remote code execution within the application context.
Web Security.reason_en: EspoCRM authenticated administrators can store crafted serialized PHP objects that are later deserialized without validation, leading to remote code execution within the application context.
Web Security.reason_zh: EspoCRM已认证管理员可存储精心构造的序列化PHP对象，随后在未经验证的情况下反序列化，导致应用程序上下文内的远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Quarkus Qute template engine reflection resolver fails to block sensitive Java internal functions, enabling authenticated users to bypass security controls and execute arbitrary code.
Web Security.reason_en: Quarkus Qute template engine reflection resolver fails to block sensitive Java internal functions, enabling authenticated users to bypass security controls and execute arbitrary code.
Web Security.reason_zh: Quarkus Qute模板引擎反射解析器未能拦截敏感的Java内部函数，使已认证用户能够绕过安全控制并执行任意代码。

Web Security.reason: Keycloak Policy Enforcer authorization bypass allows any authenticated user to circumvent role, scope, and UMA permission checks by manipulating URL paths, compromising application access controls.
Web Security.reason_en: Keycloak Policy Enforcer authorization bypass allows any authenticated user to circumvent role, scope, and UMA permission checks by manipulating URL paths, compromising application access controls.
Web Security.reason_zh: Keycloak Policy Enforcer授权绕过漏洞允许任何已认证用户通过操纵URL路径规避角色、作用域和UMA权限检查，从而破坏应用访问控制。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Dataverse enables remote code execution, directly threatening backend data services.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Dataverse enables remote code execution, directly threatening backend data services.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Microsoft Dataverse中不受信任数据的反序列化可导致远程代码执行，直接威胁后端数据服务。

Databases & Middleware.reason: SQL injection in Baserow's formula function allows authenticated users to manipulate underlying database queries and extract sensitive data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: SQL injection in Baserow's formula function allows authenticated users to manipulate underlying database queries and extract sensitive data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Baserow公式函数中的SQL注入漏洞允许已认证用户操纵底层数据库查询并提取敏感数据。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Unsafe deserialization in Dynamics Business Central permits remote code execution in enterprise middleware, threatening critical business logic and data layers.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in Dynamics Business Central permits remote code execution in enterprise middleware, threatening critical business logic and data layers.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Dynamics Business Central中的不安全反序列化可在企业中间件中实现远程代码执行，威胁关键业务逻辑与数据层。

Databases & Middleware.reason: CVSS 8.8 heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server中CVSS评分为8.8的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已认证攻击者以提权后的权限执行任意代码。

Databases & Middleware.reason: CVSS 7.5 stack-based buffer overflow in SQL Server presents a direct path to remote code execution when handling malformed T-SQL commands.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 stack-based buffer overflow in SQL Server presents a direct path to remote code execution when handling malformed T-SQL commands.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server中CVSS评分为7.5的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞在处理畸形T-SQL命令时可直接导致远程代码执行。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Unsafe deserialization in SQL Server permits unauthenticated network RCE, leading to complete backend compromise and potential data exfiltration.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in SQL Server permits unauthenticated network RCE, leading to complete backend compromise and potential data exfiltration.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server中的不安全反序列化漏洞允许未认证网络环境下的远程代码执行（RCE），导致后端完全失陷及潜在的数据外泄。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Improper authentication in ASP.NET Core allows network attackers to bypass access controls and elevate privileges, impacting hosted microservices.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Improper authentication in ASP.NET Core allows network attackers to bypass access controls and elevate privileges, impacting hosted microservices.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中的身份验证缺陷允许网络攻击者绕过访问控制并提升权限，影响托管的微服务。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Path traversal vulnerability in the .NET runtime enables local privilege escalation by accessing restricted filesystem directories outside intended scopes.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in the .NET runtime enables local privilege escalation by accessing restricted filesystem directories outside intended scopes.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: .NET运行时中的路径遍历漏洞可通过访问预期范围之外的受限文件系统目录实现本地提权。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Unsafe link resolution in .NET allows local attackers to redirect file operations to unintended targets, potentially escalating privileges.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Unsafe link resolution in .NET allows local attackers to redirect file operations to unintended targets, potentially escalating privileges.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: .NET中的不安全链接解析漏洞允许本地攻击者将文件操作重定向至非预期目标，可能导致权限提升。

Databases & Middleware.reason: SQL injection in Microsoft Configuration Manager permits adjacent network attackers to manipulate backend databases and escalate privileges.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft Configuration Manager permits adjacent network attackers to manipulate backend databases and escalate privileges.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Microsoft Configuration Manager中的SQL注入漏洞允许相邻网络攻击者操纵后端数据库并提升权限。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Out-of-bounds write in the .NET runtime enables unauthenticated remote code execution, affecting cross-platform middleware deployments.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the .NET runtime enables unauthenticated remote code execution, affecting cross-platform middleware deployments.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: .NET运行时中的越界写入漏洞可实现未认证的远程代码执行，影响跨平台中间件部署。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits remote code execution over the network, directly threatening database integrity, confidentiality, and availability.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits remote code execution over the network, directly threatening database integrity, confidentiality, and availability.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，直接威胁数据库的完整性、机密性和可用性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows network-based privilege escalation, enabling attackers to gain elevated control over database instances and underlying systems.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows network-based privilege escalation, enabling attackers to gain elevated control over database instances and underlying systems.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许基于网络的权限提升，使攻击者能够获得对数据库实例及底层系统的更高控制权。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Insecure deserialization in .NET enables unauthenticated remote code execution, widely affecting backend application servers and enterprise middleware platforms.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Insecure deserialization in .NET enables unauthenticated remote code execution, widely affecting backend application servers and enterprise middleware platforms.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: .NET中的不安全反序列化漏洞可实现未认证的远程代码执行，广泛影响后端应用服务器及企业中间件平台。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows authorized network attackers to execute code remotely, posing a direct risk to database server integrity and sensitive data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows authorized network attackers to execute code remotely, posing a direct risk to database server integrity and sensitive data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许经授权的网路攻击者远程执行代码，对数据库服务器完整性及敏感数据构成直接风险。

Databases & Middleware.reason: CVSS 8.8 stack-based buffer overflow in IBM Planning Analytics permits arbitrary code execution, threatening analytical middleware stability.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 stack-based buffer overflow in IBM Planning Analytics permits arbitrary code execution, threatening analytical middleware stability.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: IBM Planning Analytics中CVSS评分为8.8的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许执行任意代码，威胁分析型中间件的稳定性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: CVSS 8.8 code injection in VSTO/SSMS enables unauthenticated network RCE, compromising database administration tools and backend systems.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 code injection in VSTO/SSMS enables unauthenticated network RCE, compromising database administration tools and backend systems.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: VSTO/SSMS中CVSS评分为8.8的代码注入漏洞可实现未认证的网络远程代码执行（RCE），导致数据库管理工具及后端系统失陷。

Databases & Middleware.reason: CVSS 8.6 uncontrolled resource consumption in IBM QRadar causes denial of service, degrading critical security monitoring and incident response capabilities.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: CVSS 8.6 uncontrolled resource consumption in IBM QRadar causes denial of service, degrading critical security monitoring and incident response capabilities.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: IBM QRadar中CVSS评分为8.6的资源消耗失控漏洞会导致拒绝服务，削弱关键的安全监控与事件响应能力。

Databases & Middleware.reason: CVSS 8.1 hardcoded cryptographic key in IBM Guardium exposes sensitive data protection mechanisms, allowing attackers to decrypt protected information.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 hardcoded cryptographic key in IBM Guardium exposes sensitive data protection mechanisms, allowing attackers to decrypt protected information.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: IBM Guardium中CVSS评分为8.1的硬编码加密密钥漏洞暴露了敏感数据保护机制，使攻击者能够解密受保护信息。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Critical remote vulnerability in Oracle Essbase allows low-privileged attackers to compromise the system via T3/IIOP protocols, potentially leading to full infrastructure takeover.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Critical remote vulnerability in Oracle Essbase allows low-privileged attackers to compromise the system via T3/IIOP protocols, potentially leading to full infrastructure takeover.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Oracle Essbase中的关键远程漏洞允许低权限攻击者通过T3/IIOP协议入侵系统，可能导致整个基础设施被接管。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Easily exploitable HTTP-based flaw in Oracle Essbase enables low-privileged network attackers to achieve complete system compromise without authentication.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Easily exploitable HTTP-based flaw in Oracle Essbase enables low-privileged network attackers to achieve complete system compromise without authentication.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Oracle Essbase中易于利用的基于HTTP的缺陷允许低权限网络攻击者在无需认证的情况下实现系统完全失陷。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Unauthenticated remote attackers can exploit this HTTP vulnerability in Oracle WebCenter Content Server to take over the application and underlying infrastructure.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote attackers can exploit this HTTP vulnerability in Oracle WebCenter Content Server to take over the application and underlying infrastructure.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 未认证的远程攻击者可利用Oracle WebCenter Content Server中的此HTTP漏洞接管应用程序及底层基础设施。

Databases & Middleware.reason: This LDAP gateway flaw in Oracle Identity Manager Connectors allows unauthenticated network attackers to compromise identity management services and associated systems.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: This LDAP gateway flaw in Oracle Identity Manager Connectors allows unauthenticated network attackers to compromise identity management services and associated systems.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Oracle Identity Manager Connectors中的此LDAP网关缺陷允许未认证的网络攻击者入侵身份管理服务及相关系统。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Unauthenticated attackers can leverage T3/IIOP protocol flaws in Oracle Identity Manager to compromise end-user self-service components and backend systems.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Unauthenticated attackers can leverage T3/IIOP protocol flaws in Oracle Identity Manager to compromise end-user self-service components and backend systems.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 未认证攻击者可利用 Oracle Identity Manager 中的 T3/IIOP 协议缺陷，破坏终端用户自助服务组件及后端系统。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Exploitation of the DBMS_VECTOR privilege in Oracle Database RDBMS allows low-privileged users to escalate privileges and compromise core database functions.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Exploitation of the DBMS_VECTOR privilege in Oracle Database RDBMS allows low-privileged users to escalate privileges and compromise core database functions.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 在 Oracle Database RDBMS 中利用 DBMS_VECTOR 权限，可使低权限用户实现权限提升并破坏核心数据库功能。

Databases & Middleware.reason: CVSS 10 vulnerability in JD Edwards Orchestrator allows unauthenticated network access via HTTP, enabling immediate remote code execution and complete system compromise.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: CVSS 10 vulnerability in JD Edwards Orchestrator allows unauthenticated network access via HTTP, enabling immediate remote code execution and complete system compromise.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: JD Edwards Orchestrator 中的 CVSS 10 级漏洞允许通过 HTTP 进行未认证网络访问，可实现即时远程代码执行及系统完全沦陷。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Core WebLogic Server flaw permits unauthenticated attackers to exploit the platform via HTTP, leading to full middleware takeover and potential data exfiltration.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Core WebLogic Server flaw permits unauthenticated attackers to exploit the platform via HTTP, leading to full middleware takeover and potential data exfiltration.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: WebLogic Server 核心缺陷允许未认证攻击者通过 HTTP 利用该平台，导致中间件被完全接管及潜在的数据泄露。

Databases & Middleware.reason: SOA Suite Adapters component is vulnerable to unauthenticated HTTP exploitation, allowing attackers to bypass authentication and execute arbitrary code remotely.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: SOA Suite Adapters component is vulnerable to unauthenticated HTTP exploitation, allowing attackers to bypass authentication and execute arbitrary code remotely.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SOA Suite Adapters 组件存在未认证 HTTP 利用漏洞，攻击者可借此绕过身份验证并远程执行任意代码。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Critical Fabric Layer vulnerability exploitable over T3 and IIOP protocols grants unauthenticated remote access, effectively neutralizing built-in security controls.

summary: Today's vulnerability landscape is dominated by high-severity flaws in the Microsoft ecosystem, with extensive remote code execution risks in Windows desktop components, SQL Server databases, and Azure cloud infrastructure. Critical attack vectors include heap buffer overflows, use-after-free errors, and unsafe deserialization that threaten endpoint stability, database integrity, and containerized workloads. Additional significant concerns affect network devices such as DNS and DHCP servers, industrial control systems from manufacturers like Siemens and Advantech, and web platforms vulnerable to SQL injection and request smuggling.
summary_en: Today's vulnerability landscape is dominated by high-severity flaws in the Microsoft ecosystem, with extensive remote code execution risks in Windows desktop components, SQL Server databases, and Azure cloud infrastructure. Critical attack vectors include heap buffer overflows, use-after-free errors, and unsafe deserialization that threaten endpoint stability, database integrity, and containerized workloads. Additional significant concerns affect network devices such as DNS and DHCP servers, industrial control systems from manufacturers like Siemens and Advantech, and web platforms vulnerable to SQL injection and request smuggling.
summary_zh: 当前的漏洞态势主要由 Microsoft 生态系统中的高危漏洞主导，Windows 桌面组件、SQL Server 数据库和 Azure 云基础设施存在广泛的远程代码执行风险。关键攻击向量包括堆缓冲区溢出、释放后使用错误以及不安全反序列化，这些漏洞威胁着终端稳定性、数据库完整性和容器化工作负载。其他重大安全隐患还涉及 DNS 和 DHCP 等网络设备、Siemens 和 Advantech 等厂商的工业控制系统，以及易受 SQL 注入和请求走私攻击影响的 Web 平台。
